retrievedContext.title: Reuse of removable hardware
retrievedContext.text:
Source ID: epa-reuse-hardware
Title: Reuse of removable hardware
Publisher: United States Environmental Protection Agency
Canonical source: https://www.epa.gov/smm/sustainable-management-construction-and-demolition-materials
Section: What Materials Can Be Reused?
Reference guidance: Removable building hardware is among the materials EPA identifies as candidates for salvage, donation, or reuse on another project.
Conditions and limitations: This is general reuse guidance. Whether a particular part fits or performs adequately requires measurements, a condition check, and the receiving project's requirements. It does not establish safety or structural suitability from a photo.

retrievedContext.title: Check a local ReStore's material donation options
retrievedContext.text:
Source ID: habitat-material-donation
Title: Check a local ReStore's material donation options
Publisher: Habitat for Humanity
Canonical source: https://www.habitat.org/restores/donate-goods
Section: What can you donate to ReStore?
Reference guidance: A local Habitat ReStore may be another donation route for new or gently used building materials. Acceptance varies by location, so contact the store with the actual item details first.
Conditions and limitations: A broad material category does not guarantee acceptance. Confirm the specific item's condition, dimensions, quantity, and the local store's current requirements. ResourceDex is not affiliated with Habitat for Humanity.

retrievedContext.title: Arrange a donation before transporting materials
retrievedContext.text:
Source ID: habitat-donation-arrangement
Title: Arrange a donation before transporting materials
Publisher: Habitat for Humanity
Canonical source: https://www.habitat.org/restores/donate-goods
Section: How do you donate items to Habitat ReStore?
Reference guidance: Contact the local ReStore to discuss the items and agree on a donation method. Confirm donation hours before traveling; they can differ from shopping hours.
Conditions and limitations: Applies to donations the local store agrees to accept. Pickup service, hours, and item eligibility must be checked directly; this reference does not arrange a pickup.

segment.text:
### **EPA Guidance on Removable Building Hardware**
* **Reference Guidance:** Removable building hardware is identified by the EPA as a candidate material for salvage, donation, or reuse on another project

* **Conditions and Limitations:** 
  * This serves only as general reuse guidance
* Whether a specific part fits or performs adequately requires taking measurements, conducting a condition check, and verifying the receiving project's specific requirements
* The guidance does not establish structural suitability or safety (such as from a photo)

### **Related Donation Route (Habitat ReStore)**
* **Reference Guidance:** A local Habitat ReStore may serve as an option for donating new or gently used building materials; however, acceptance varies by location, and donors must contact the specific store with item details first

* **Conditions and Limitations:**
  * Falling under a broad material category does not guarantee acceptance
* The donor must confirm the item's condition, dimensions, quantity, and the specific store's current requirements
* Donation hours, eligibility, and whether pickup service is offered must be verified directly with the local store prior to transporting materials, as donation hours can differ from retail hours
